issue.title: test_close_snoozed_task_cancels_its_bead_snooze_gate hardcodes a past snooze wake time
issue.description: Discovered as a pre-existing failure (verified via git stash on sase_11 at commit 9e2d95bb0) while running just check/just test-scoped for unrelated plan 202609/v2_adoption_unwedges_v1.md; not caused by that plan's diff.

task_type_fields.impact: The test calls project.snooze(task.id, until="2026-09-01T00:00:00Z", ...) with a literal wake time that is now in the past (today is 2026-09-03), so sase_core's bead_snooze rejects it with ValueError: bead snooze wake time must be in the future. Same defect class as closed bead sase-t9 (a different file/literal, sase-t9's fix did not sweep this instance). Fix: compute the wake time relative to a frozen/injected clock or datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(...) instead of a hardcoded literal.
